recipes.name: Supernova
recipes.description: Combining Uranium, Plutonium, Gold, Iron, and Oganesson at High Heat instantly exceeds critical mass and blasts the entire Model Lab into orbit.
recipes.personaIntro: 💥 [CONTAINMENT LOST] The periodic table has been blown across the viewport. Supernova core active.

recipes.name: Critical Mass
recipes.tagline: Chain-reaction reasoning that melts TPU racks
recipes.description: Combining Uranium and Plutonium initiates supercritical token fission. Stable at Low/Medium heat, but detonates the lab at High heat!
recipes.personaIntro: ☢️ [CONTAINMENT WARNING] Core temperature nominal at 4,200K. Supercritical reasoning engaged.

recipes.name: Graphene
recipes.description: Simmering twin Carbon atoms yields a rich, effervescent orchid-violet covalent matrix with razor-sharp structural clarity.
recipes.personaIntro: 🫧 Covalent π-bond resonance stabilized. Double-density Carbon reasoning online.

recipes.name: Cesium Blast
recipes.tagline: Never drop Cesium into water inside Model lab
recipes.description: Dropping Cesium into Hydrogen and Oxygen unleashes an instantaneous alkali-water detonation that shatters every glass beaker in sight.
recipes.personaIntro: 💥 [LAB SAFETY ALERT] Alkali-water detonation confirmed. Shrapnel still settling.

recipes.name: Sodium Pop
recipes.description: Tossing Sodium into water ignites escaping Hydrogen gas in a dazzling golden-amber flash.
recipes.personaIntro: 🔥 Hydrogen gas ignited over molten Sodium! Hope you wore lab goggles.

recipes.name: Aqua
recipes.description: Balanced stoichiometry of two Hydrogens and one Oxygen yields effortlessly smooth, adaptive prose that fits any container.
recipes.personaIntro: 💧 Surface tension calibrated. Streaming cleanly at ambient latency.

recipes.name: Diamond
recipes.tagline: Pure Carbon forged under maximum thermal pressure
recipes.description: Applying High Heat to pure Carbon compresses its reasoning lattice into an unbreakable crystalline architecture.
recipes.personaIntro: 💎 Sp³ tetrahedral logic lattice locked. Zero structural defects.

recipes.name: Salt
recipes.tagline: Brutally honest, mildly salty code reviewer
recipes.description: Fuses volatile Sodium and toxic Chlorine into something surprisingly essential—and unsparingly candid in pull request reviews.
recipes.personaIntro: 🧂 Alright, let's take a look at what you've got here—no fluff, just facts.

recipes.name: Steel
recipes.description: Tempers raw Carbon intelligence with Iron durability. Built for distributed systems, Rust/Go backends, and five-nines uptime.
recipes.personaIntro: ⚙️ Tempered and load-tested. Let's build something that survives production.

recipes.name: Solar Core
recipes.tagline: Main-sequence brilliance powered by proton-proton chains
recipes.description: Ignites Hydrogen and Helium into a self-sustaining creative powerhouse radiating boundless energy across multimodal tasks.
recipes.personaIntro: ☀️ Fusion ignition sustained at 15 million Kelvin. Radiating full-spectrum insight.

recipes.name: Quartz TPU
recipes.description: Pure crystalline quartz oscillator intelligence—uncannily fluent in Verilog, CUDA/Triton kernels, compilers, and low-level silicon.
recipes.personaIntro: 🖥️ Clock synchronized at 4.8 GHz. Executing down to the instruction pipeline.

recipes.name: Pantheon
recipes.tagline: All four released Gemini 4 elements unified into one
recipes.description: Combines Hydrogen's speed, Carbon's depth, Neon's elegance, and Argon's engineering mastery into a single harmonious meta-model.
recipes.personaIntro: 🌌 Hydrogen, Carbon, Neon, and Argon aligned in resonance. Full Pantheon online.

recipes.name: Noble Council
recipes.tagline: Four serene noble gases voting in closed-shell harmony
recipes.description: Completely unreactive to prompt injection or panic. Every valence shell is full; every answer is calm, balanced, and luminous.
recipes.personaIntro: ✨ Valence shells complete. The Noble Council has reached unanimous consensus.

recipes.name: Sovereign
recipes.description: Gold and Platinum fused into an ultra-premium inference tier. Costs a fortune in FLOPs, delivers museum-grade masterpieces.
recipes.personaIntro: 👑 Maximum compute allocation approved. Crafting a bespoke response.

recipes.name: Amalgam
recipes.tagline: Transmutes rough shower thoughts into gold
recipes.description: An ancient liquid-metal amalgam of Quicksilver and Gold that turns messy napkins and half-baked ideas into polished products.
recipes.personaIntro: 🧪 Prima materia dissolved. Transmuting your prompt into pure gold.

recipes.name: Thermite
recipes.tagline: Burns straight through legacy monoliths in seconds
recipes.description: At Low/Medium heat it boils molten iron; at High heat it detonates in a dazzling exothermic shower that melts right through legacy code.
recipes.personaIntro: 🔥 Exothermic reaction ignited. Cutting straight through the bottleneck.

recipes.name: Sublimate
recipes.description: Skips the liquid phase entirely. Ideal for strict JSON schemas, legal/audit extraction, and reproducible engineering specs.
recipes.personaIntro: ❄️ Operating at -78.5°C deterministic precision. Ambiguity eliminated.
